title: Add documentation for 6 missing plugins
body:
Six plugins existed in the monorepo but lacked documentation and couldn't be demonstrated in the site: timeline, chatbot, calendar, calendar-view, gantt, and map.

## Changes

**InteractiveDemo component**
- Added lazy imports for all 6 missing plugins

**Plugin documentation** (created)
- `plugin-timeline.mdx` - Vertical/horizontal/Gantt timeline layouts
- `plugin-chatbot.mdx` - Chat interface with message history
- `plugin-calendar-view.mdx` - Standalone calendar (month/week/day views)
- `plugin-calendar.mdx` - ObjectQL-integrated calendar
- `plugin-gantt.mdx` - ObjectQL Gantt chart with dependencies
- `plugin-map.mdx` - ObjectQL location visualization

**Navigation updates**
- Reorganized `plugins/index.md` into categories (Data Visualization, Content & Editing, Workflows & Tasks)
- Added all plugins to `meta.json` sidebar navigation
- Updated bundle size table

**Site configuration**
- Added workspace dependencies for new plugins to `apps/site/package.json`

All plugins now appear in the documentation with interactive examples.
